title: Chinese Tomato and Egg Stir-Fry (Fan Qie Chao Dan)
ingredients: 4 large ripe tomatoes, cut into wedges
3 scallions (green onions), whites and greens separated and chopped
1/2 tsp toasted sesame oil + 1/2 tsp Shaoxing wine (for eggs)
1 tbsp ketchup (optional restaurant secret for color and tang)
1/2 tsp white pepper & 3/4 tsp kosher salt
2 tbsp neutral oil, plus steamed white rice for serving
instructions: Beat the eggs vigorously with 1/4 tsp salt, white pepper, Shaoxing wine, and sesame oil.
Heat 1.5 tbsp oil in a wok or skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Pour in the eggs and scramble into soft, billowing curds in 45 seconds; transfer immediately to a plate.

Add remaining 1/2 tbsp oil to the pan and sauté scallion whites and garlic for 20 seconds. Add tomato wedges, sugar, salt, and ketchup; stir-fry for 2–3 minutes until the tomatoes soften and release a rich, glossy sauce.
Return the soft scrambled eggs and scallion greens to the pan, toss gently for 30 seconds so the eggs soak up the savory-sweet tomato juices, and serve over hot steamed rice.
